precondition.details: The plugin formats timestamps into HTML strings for console display without performing any prior validation or escaping checks.

root_cause.details: Formatted timestamp strings are returned directly to the console output without sanitization, enabling arbitrary HTML injection.

fix_intent.details: The patch wraps formatted timestamp strings in a sanitization utility to strip unsafe HTML before returning the final output.
